text:
emma: Quick recap from the failover postmortem — collecting action items and owners. Short thread, assign who can take each.

raj: Thanks. Can we surface the recurring symptoms we saw in EU->US routing shifts? I logged two similar patterns in the last 6 weeks.

oliver: I tallied them — BGP flap + transient regional LB saturation twice, and KV cache missstorm during failback. Pattern suggests route churn + cache warmup.

sara: Agreed. Also noticed restore runbook step 4 is vague about snapshot consistency checks. Put me down to own that write-up.

emma: Assignments so far:
- Routing pattern analysis: @raj (2w)
- Snapshot consistency doc + runbook clarifications: @sara (1w)
- DNS failover TTL/health checks audit: needs owner
- Game-day checklist revision (roles + playbook owner handoff): @natalie (3d)

jin: I can do the DNS audit. I'll validate TTLs, health-check hysteresis, and failover window config. ETA: 4 business days.

raj: I'll start the routing deep-dive. Will pull AS path logs and correlate to cloud egress metrics. ETA: 10 business days, will add interim findings by EOD Friday.

oliver: For KV cache warmup, I propose adding an automated pre-warm step to restore runbooks after failover. I can prototype a wrapper script.

sara: Started a draft diff for runbook step 4 — adding `verify_snapshot_consistency()` and explicit threshold checks. Posting PR stub after this thread.

natalie: Scheduling a mini game-day next Thu 09:00 PT — focuses on DNS failover and runbook dry-run. Will invite oncall, eng-sre, and platform.

emma: Nice. Two more items:
- Backup retention audit (cross-region snapshot lifecycle): owner? — @oliver offered to help with storage costs estimate.
- Alert tuning for cascading failures (reduce noise, add severity on multi-region signal): need owner.

oliver: I'll take backup retention audit as well; I'll split tasks and update the action tracker. ETA: 1 week.

jin: For alert tuning I'll coordinate with @emma and platform. I can propose a rule set that promotes alerts to P0 only when both routing anomalies + backup restore failures present.

emma: Cool. Please add all items to the postmortem board and tag with the postmortem id pm-2026-04-failover. Use labels: owner, eta, status, deps.

ops-bot: Link added — https://redwood.internal/pm/pm-2026-04-failover (permissions: infra-team, eng-sre)

raj: Quick note — discovered one edge case: egress-rate-limiter kicked in during failback window for a small subset of flows. Will include mitigation (soft limits during failover) in deep-dive.

sara: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/482 — adds snapshot verification and example verification script. Please review.

natalie: Game-day invite sent. Agenda pinned in calendar invite. Prep task: each owner to bring a 5-min demo of their mitigation.

emma: Follow-ups summary (I'll keep this thread as tracker until closure):
- raj: routing analysis (owner)
- sara: runbook snapshot checks + PR (owner)
- jin: DNS failover audit + alert gating (owner)
- oliver: backup retention cost + KV warmup prototype (owner)
- natalie: schedule/facilitate game-day (owner)

emma: Target check-in cadence: 3x weekly quick sync until items marked 'in-review', then weekly until closed. Post any blockers here.

raj: First interim posted (logs + initial hypothesis): https://redwood.internal/logs/5271 — ping if you need access.

sara: Noted a dependency: storage team needs to expose snapshot CRC endpoint for verification. Filing an infra request now.

oliver: I'll prototype KV pre-warm script and attach it to the runbook draft by EOD Friday.

jin: DNS audit first pass done, will post doc with TTL/health-check matrix tomorrow AM.

natalie: If anyone needs additional attendees in game-day add them to the invite — ops, sec, storage recommended.

emma: Thanks all. Closing note: if any item slips beyond ETA, mark as 'blocked' and include reason. We'll surface to oncall lead and product if needed. :thumbsup:

(ops-bot): reminder: postmortem pm-2026-04-failover action-items due 2026-05-10 if not closed.
